user.title: Lionel Train Controller
user.description: Select the LionChief locomotive to add. Make sure it is powered on and in range of a Bluetooth adapter.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Discovered Lionel train **{name}** at address `{address}`. Do you want to add it to Home Assistant?

reload_integration.description: Reloads Lionel Train Controller config entries to re-establish the Bluetooth connection.

entry_id.description: The config entry to reload. Leave empty to reload every Lionel locomotive.
